Name Prometheus 2
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1.5U
Organisation USSOCOM (US Special Operations Command)
Institution Military
Entity Government (Civil / Military)
Country US
Manufacturer AIVT by Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL)
Partners U.S. Department of Defense
Oneliner

Demonstrate improved CubeSat platform.
Description

Improving from lessons learned on Block 1. Replacing single coil with 3 torque rods, increasing momentum wheel storage, adding star field sensor, adding GPS receiver. Possibility to add 1.5U payload at the end of the satellite.
